sprite.name: Grrrol
sprite.notes: A rolling enemy based on NSMBU's Grrrol. It rolls along the ground, reverses when it hits walls, hurts players on contact, cannot be stomped, and crushes enemies in its path.
sprite.yoshinotes: Yoshi cannot eat Grrrol. Contact with it will still hurt Yoshi.

value.title: No-spawn Triggering Event ID
value.comment: This determines which event prevents the Grrrol from spawning. A value of 0 disables this behavior.

checkbox.title: No slow wall bounce
checkbox.comment: When enabled, the Grrrol keeps its normal bounce timing instead of using a slower wall bounce.

checkbox.title: Only spawns when facing player
checkbox.comment: When enabled, the Grrrol only spawns if its starting direction faces the player.

list.title: Direction
list.comment: This determines which direction the Grrrol begins rolling in.

list.title: Speed
list.comment: This determines how fast the Grrrol rolls.

list.title: Size
list.comment: This determines whether the Grrrol uses its normal size or its larger Mega variant.

sprite.name: Grrrol Spawner
sprite.notes: Spawns Grrrols from the NSMBU-style Grrrol pipe spawner.

value.title: Spawn Delay
value.comment: Used when Spawn Frequency is 0. The max delay is only 255 frames (60 frames is equal to roughly 1 second).
